features.name: duration
features.description: Raw duration of the event interval computed as end minus start
features.expected_model_benefit: Direct linear signal capturing event span length useful for SVM margin separation

features.name: log_duration
features.description: Log-transformed duration to compress skewed distribution of event intervals
features.expected_model_benefit: Smoothed continuous feature reducing skew for better linear SVM margin

features.name: log_size
features.description: Log-transformed size to normalize the heavily right-skewed size distribution
features.expected_model_benefit: Normalized continuous size signal suitable for linear SVM hyperplane

features.name: size_per_duration
features.description: Ratio of size to duration representing density or throughput of the event
features.expected_model_benefit: Composite ratio feature capturing interaction between size and time span for linear separation

features.name: log_size_per_duration
features.description: Log-transformed size-to-duration ratio for smooth density measure
features.expected_model_benefit: Smooth log-ratio useful as a continuous linear projection for SVM

features.name: normalized_start
features.description: Start time normalized by training-set max start (1936311) to range [0,1]
features.expected_model_benefit: Normalized temporal position useful for linear SVM without scale dominance

features.name: normalized_end
features.description: End time normalized by training-set max end (1965726) to range [0,1]
features.expected_model_benefit: Normalized end position providing smooth continuous signal for linear SVM

features.name: id_normalized
features.description: ID normalized by training-set max id (4088) to range [0,1]
features.expected_model_benefit: Normalized sequential identifier capturing ordering effects for linear margin

features.name: event_size_interaction
features.description: Interaction between binary event flag and log-transformed size
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures differential size effect conditioned on event type for linear SVM

features.name: event_duration_interaction
features.description: Interaction between binary event flag and log-transformed duration
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures differential duration effect conditioned on event type for linear SVM

features.name: size_deviation_from_mean
features.description: Standardized deviation of size from training mean (439.18) scaled by training std (952.83)
features.expected_model_benefit: Z-score style normalization enabling linear SVM to use size as a well-scaled continuous feature

features.name: temporal_coverage_score
features.description: Semantic assessment of how much of the total observed time range the event interval covers, scored from 0 (very narrow interval relative to full range) to 1 (spans nearly the full observed time range), based on duration relative to max observed range of ~1965726
features.expected_model_benefit: Interpretable continuous severity measure of temporal span useful as a smooth linear feature for SVM
